utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Okay, I’ll wait for Noah’s update and let Mina know what I hear. Faye should send you the drop-off times tonight, right?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, that’s right — Faye should send the drop-off times tonight, and then we can line up Monday through Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I’ll wait on Noah’s update and then pass it along to Mina. Tuesday at 7:30 still works for the carpool, right?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s still set for 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane, and I’ve got spots saved for Opal and Dane. Sam’s ready to help, and I can pull in Ira if we need the extra seat.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll tell everyone it’s 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane, and Hana’s coordinating it with Jules keeping folks updated.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks — please keep everyone posted, and if Monday or Wednesday need lining up, Rey can handle the stops.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Gus — if I’m a little late again, I’ll head to 14 Cedar Lane for the 8:10 carpool and I appreciate the wiggle room.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem — Rey’s good for a 7:30 pickup on Mondays and Wednesdays, and Sam can help too if you need backup.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Gus — that helps a lot. If I’m running late, I’ll stick with the 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane and let Sam work around it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Tuesday at 7:30 at 14 Cedar Lane still works. Oren, you’re good to help and be ready then.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, 7:30 at 14 Cedar Lane still works for me. I’ll be ready, and Sam can help too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — Sam helping works too. See you Tuesday at 7:30 at 14 Cedar Lane.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So Hana’s definitely leaving with the carpool, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I’m coordinating it, but I still need to confirm the stops and timing with Gus before we leave.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — you’re in the carpool, but the stops and timing still need Gus’s confirmation, right?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: If the school drop-off times line up, I can do carpool this week. I’ll send the drop-off times tonight with the pickup time and place.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks—Tuesday at 7:30 is still the carpool time. Send the drop-off times when you can, and I’ll keep the pickup list updated.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, Tuesday at 7:30 works for me if the drop-off times line up. I’ll send the details tonight and include the pickup time and place.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Any word from Rosa on the pickup spot and time yet? I can pass it along once she confirms.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Not yet — Rosa said she’ll send me the pickup spot and time once she confirms them. I’m keeping an eye out for it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — once Rosa confirms, I’ll let the others know right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, as long as Gus lines up the timing and stop list first. Once Hana confirms the stops with him, Vik can let everyone know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I can ride, and Gus can keep the timing and stops lined up if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Perfect — since it’s at the church parking lot, let’s keep the timing tight and wait for Hana’s confirmation before anyone heads out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help — the carpool is set for 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane, and I’ll save Dane a spot.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks — I’m still filling a seat, and it’s good to know Hana and Leo are going too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — we’re still at 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane, and I’ll keep Dane’s spot saved.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help line up the stops and timing for Mondays and Wednesdays. Gus can help too, and Sam’s already pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great — let’s keep it simple: the carpool is at 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane. Vik can repeat that to everyone so it stays clear.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane is easy to share. Vik repeating it should help keep everyone on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, I’m a bit behind on the carpool stuff. Vik can let everyone know once it’s set, and Cleo’s got the list of who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hana’s coordinating it, and Sam’s helping too. If you need another seat filled, Ira can probably take it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, got it — thanks for catching me up. I’ll wait for Hana’s update and see if Ira needs a spot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, Rosa can keep Bo posted if anything changes. Cleo already has the pickup list ready, and Ira or Gus can help if we end up needing an extra seat.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sounds good — I’ll let Opal know the pickup is set at the church lot around 8:00, and we can loop in Gus if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — thanks, Rosa. If anything shifts, just keep Gus in the loop and Bo posted too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Tuesday at 7:30 is still the carpool time, and I’ve got the pickup list. Sam, Oren, and Tess are all set, with Kira coordinating and Noah sending me the list.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Actually, the pickup is 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane, and Hana’s coordinating it. Jules will help line everyone up and keep folks updated.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks for the update — I’ll note 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane and that Hana’s coordinating. I’ve got it as Sam, Oren, Tess, and Jules helping out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’ll check whether the carpool time changed and let you know. If it still lines up with school drop-off, Faye can do it this week.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks — I’ll wait for your update and then pass it along to Mina. For now I’m still hearing Tuesday at 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I’ll check if it’s still Tuesday at 7:30 and tell you once I know. Cleo’s got the bring-what list, so I’ll ask her too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane works for me. Gus can keep the timing and stops lined up if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Tuesday at 7:30 at 14 Cedar Lane is the one we’re using. Gus can help keep things lined up, but the time hasn’t changed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — 7:30 at 14 Cedar Lane then. I’m good with that, and Gus can keep the stops lined up if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep — the carpool is still set for 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane, and I’ll save Dane a spot.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good — 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane is clear. Please keep Monday and Wednesday simple, and let Rey know the pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Will do — I’ll keep Monday and Wednesday simple and let Rey know the pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, that should cover the carpool then. I’m glad Jules can take Maya and Ben at 7:30, and I’ll keep filling the extra seat.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that works. I’ll confirm the stops and timing with Gus, and I’m keeping Quinn’s spot flexible.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — once Gus confirms the stops, we should be all set.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: If the school drop-off times line up, I can do carpool this week. Vik can repeat the simple plan to everyone, and Nell can pass Noah’s update along to Mina.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—what time should I plan to leave for the church parking lot? I’ll keep an eye out for Noah’s update from Nell.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: If the drop-off times work, I’d plan to leave a little before 8 so we’re not rushed. Once Nell sends Noah’s update, we can confirm the final time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Opal — 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane still works for me, and I may be a little late again. I appreciate the wiggle room.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No problem — I’ve got you down for 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane, and I’ll keep the wiggle room in mind.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Opal — that works for me. I’ll do my best to be there by 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Rey’s good for the carpool on Mondays and Wednesdays, and 7:30 pickup works for him. If anything changes, Cleo will keep you and Tess in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — can you confirm Sam, Bo, and Leo are still set for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can confirm Rey’s set for Mondays and Wednesdays at 7:30, and Cleo will keep you and Tess posted if anything changes. I don’t have updates on Sam, Bo, or Leo right now.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s set for 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane, and I’ve got spots saved for Opal and Dane. Sam’s ready, and if we need the extra seat, Ira can hop in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll keep everyone posted, and it’s good to know Hana and the others are lined up. If there’s a little wiggle room, we can always use it for Ira.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good — I’ll keep the carpool tight at 8:10 from 14 Cedar Lane and let folks know. If anything shifts, we can still count on Ira for that extra seat.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Kira’s coordinating the 7:30 departure, and Quinn already has spots for Opal and Dane. I’ll keep Hana and Leo in mind too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good — the carpool’s still on, and I’ll swing by on time. If anyone drops out or the plan shifts, I’ll keep Gus posted.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — that helps a lot. I’ll keep Hana and Leo in mind, and if anything changes, I’ll let Kira know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, 7:30 at 14 Cedar Lane still works for me. Hana’s coordinating it, and Sam’s helping too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sounds good — I’ll confirm it’s 8:00 at the church parking lot and let Opal know the pickup is set.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—just to be clear, it’s still 7:30 at 14 Cedar Lane for me. Could you stick with that and let Hana know?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sam’s helping with it, and Gus can line up the stops and timing. Oren should be ready by 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds good. I can check with Ira to help fill a seat if needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be helpful. Eli’s only thinking about Mondays and Wednesdays, so Ira could really make the rest easier.
